description: The Black & Decker PHV1810 is a smaller, quieter and easier-to-clean vac with the same superior suction power as the original, best-selling Pivot Vac. It also features a patented nozzle design which pivots to access tight spots from any angle and on-board brush and extendable crevice tool. Another key feature is the removable, washable, translucent, bag less dirt bowl - which makes for easy, hygienic cleanup as well as holding 40% more dirt & debris than the original Pivot Vac. Finally, this vac folds in half for compact charging and storage. Imported. Dimensions: Measures 6 wide by 11.125 long by 7 tall/deep
